text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's composition on its own tells you almost nothing. Women are heavily represented in broadcast news HR and editorial management, so an all-women panel can easily arise by chance or by org structure. There's no evidence panels favour their own sex in any consistent direction. Leading with it also reads as sour, and it's the weakest card you hold.

Your stronger point is procedural: you requested written reasons two weeks ago and got silence. Chase that in writing, with a deadline, citing the employer's own recruitment policy. Ask for the scoring against the published criteria.

If those reasons turn out to be thin, inconsistent, or invent criteria not in the advert — that's when you have something. "Digital media" may genuinely have been the deciding factor.
